architectural_risks.description: Both /v1/loyalty/tiers and /v1/loyalty/progress APIs require the additional query parameter include_special_tiers=true to include special tier data (5yr, 10yr, Legend, Perintis). If this parameter is omitted from either call, special tiers will not appear in the UI silently.
architectural_risks.mitigation: Yonathan confirmed this parameter is required for both /tiers and /progress. Both calls must always include include_special_tiers=true.
architectural_risks.testability_note: Call /v1/loyalty/tiers and /v1/loyalty/progress without include_special_tiers=true; verify that special tiers (Juara 5 Tahun, Juara 10 Tahun, Legend, Perintis) are absent from the catalogue UI. Then call with the parameter and verify all 8 levels appear.
architectural_risks.rfc_section_ref: Screen changes - New Page (LoyaltyCatalogueFragment) AC item 9 and Loyalty Page AC item 11

architectural_risks.description: The group field ordering in the /v1/loyalty/tiers API response directly controls FE badge grouping logic. Contiguous items with the same group value are visually grouped; a different value starts a new group. A change in BE ordering silently breaks FE grouping without an error.
architectural_risks.mitigation: Yonathan explicitly warned: 'ordering here is important as it will affect FE group separation logic.' BE must guarantee stable ordering across responses.
architectural_risks.testability_note: Test with an API response where tier items alternate group values (e.g., monthly, tahunan, monthly) and verify FE does not incorrectly merge them. Test that Bulanan/Tahunan/Penghargaan Spesial use green color and Penghormatan Tertinggi uses orange.
architectural_risks.rfc_section_ref: Screen changes - New Page API response mapping Logic item 2-3

architectural_risks.description: The yearly progress tracker (Pencapaian saya tab) depends on backdated performance data loaded via CSV. If data is missing for a driver for a specific month or year, the FE must handle this with x-icon states. Risk: crash or incorrect empty state if missing-data handling is incomplete.
architectural_risks.mitigation: BE sends x icon_url for missing months. For an entire year with no data, all 12 monthly slots display x icons. Petrick confirmed: 'In the case where there's missing data on a particular month, we send the x icon.'
architectural_risks.testability_note: Test with accounts that have no data for specific years in progress_history; verify x icons appear per month. Test with accounts with no historical data at all (pre-2018 drivers); verify empty state displays. Test with backdated data starting from 2016.
architectural_risks.rfc_section_ref: Screen changes - Loyalty Page (Pencapaian saya calendar) and comments Jul 29

architectural_risks.description: LoyaltyCatalogueFragment is reused for two distinct flows: the 8-level programme catalogue (entry from Profile Page) and the benefit/achievement page (entry from Loyalty Page). A flag passed from the calling page determines which content to render. Incorrect flag handling silently renders the wrong content.
architectural_risks.mitigation: Yonathan confirmed: 'Reuse the catalogue pages and adjust the UI based on the passed flag from the previous page.' The calling screen hardcodes the flag at the call site.
architectural_risks.testability_note: Navigate to LoyaltyCatalogueFragment from both entry points (Profile Page PAM banner and Loyalty Page benefit banner); verify distinct content and API calls (v1/tiers vs v2/rewards) for each flow.
architectural_risks.rfc_section_ref: Screen changes - Loyalty Page AC item 9 (Logic section)

architectural_risks.description: The red dot on the Pencapaian saya (Achievement) tab is stored locally and reset on clear cache, clear data, or app reinstall. This means the first-time indicator reappears after reinstall, which may confuse returning users.
architectural_risks.mitigation: Accepted behavior per AC item 10: 'Red dot will be gone when clear cache, data or uninstall.' No server-side persistence planned.
architectural_risks.testability_note: Install app, open the Pencapaian saya tab to dismiss the red dot, uninstall and reinstall, verify red dot reappears.
architectural_risks.rfc_section_ref: Screen changes - Loyalty Page AC item 10

scope_summary: PAM 8 Levels Relaunch (M1) for the GoPartner Driver app (Indonesia): a revamped loyalty experience replacing the 3-level PAM with an 8-level programme. Covers the Profile PAM entry banner, the 8 Levels catalogue, the revamped Level Saya page (Performa saya / Pencapaian saya tabs, Poin Swadaya), the yearly progress calendar, the benefits/achievement page, special recognition badges, and the SDF/Kilat/Box Point Swadaya component. Gated behind giab_pam_revamp (kill switch) and is_point_swadaya_kilat_enabled. Frontend-only; internal Stargate portal (M1-08) is out of mobile scope.
risk_assessment: RISK-01: include_special_tiers=true required on /v1/loyalty/tiers and /v1/loyalty/progress or special tiers vanish silently.
RISK-02: /v1/loyalty/tiers group ordering drives FE badge grouping; BE reordering breaks grouping without error.
RISK-03: yearly progress depends on backdated CSV data; missing-month handling (x icons) must not crash or misrender empty states.
RISK-04: LoyaltyCatalogueFragment reused for catalogue and benefit flows via a passed flag; wrong flag renders wrong content.
RISK-05: Pencapaian saya red dot is local-only; reappears after clear-cache/reinstall.
iOS implementation undefined (OQ-01) — cross-platform parity unverifiable.
Design context DEGRADED — element locators unavailable; automation binding blocked until re-export.

prd_vs_figma_gaps.gap_description: design_context is DEGRADED (preflight BLOCKED — export lacks formatVersion 2 + geometry). No screens, elements, states or ui_flow are available, so every PRD screen (8 Levels Catalogue, Level Saya tabs, Pencapaian calendar, Benefit page, Profile badges) is un-verifiable against design. All scenario steps were derived from PRD+RFC copy strings, not from design tokens.

Yearly calendar copy ('Awal periode YYYY' green start, 'Akhir periode YYYY' red end, '{X} dari 12 kali jadi Mitra Juara') is dynamic; no design frame available to confirm placement/colours or the 3-year top-row layout.
Full finalized copy deck not supplied (PRD note) — UI-copy assertions use the ID strings present in the PRD only; confirm against the UX Writer's deck.

prd_vs_rfc_gaps.gap_description: PRD calls SDF/Kilat/Box Point Swadaya 'P0 scope' (M1-09) while RFC experimentation_matrix scopes is_point_swadaya_kilat_enabled under 'Out of scope M1'. Confirm whether M1-09 ships in M1.

PRD names cohort configs generically (pam_8_levels_entry_point_cohort_config, cek_level_saya_performance_page_cohort_config); RFC names giab_pam_revamp + is_point_swadaya_kilat_enabled. Reconcile flag identities.
Benefit page endpoint conflict (OQ-03): PRD/RFC screen table lists /v1/loyalty/benefit but AC states /v2/loyalty/rewards. Reported as a gap, not silently resolved.
PRD applicable_platforms=[android, ios] but RFC only names Android Kotlin classes; iOS parity/identifiers undefined (OQ-01).

rfc_vs_impl_plan_gaps.gap_description: No plan_context.json (impl plan) supplied — cannot verify that RISK-01..05 (include_special_tiers param, group ordering, missing-data x-icons, catalogue-flag reuse, local red-dot), the SHARED_PREFS key pam_achievement_tab_red_dot_seen, NTP-based year selection, and required screens/view-models are accounted for in implementation. Verify against the dev's change_context post-build.

missing_hooks: No plan_context test hooks supplied (method:deeplink / hook_id) — navigation resolved via RFC deep link (catalogue) and regression deeplink dictionary (loyalty/home) plus corroborated Profile login+tap preamble.
gojekdriver://loyalty/catalogue not yet in the repo deeplink dictionary (new screen) — sourced from RFC.
No login/state-injection hook — Profile scenarios use the corpus-corroborated 'log in + tap profile icon' preamble.
